name: Game.GetFormFromFile("Skyrim.esm") simplification
description: Flags Game.GetFormFromFile(id, "Skyrim.esm"), which is exactly what Game.GetForm(id) already does.
definition: Flags, as a `[warning]`, a qualified `Game.GetFormFromFile` call whose file name argument is the literal `"Skyrim.esm"` (positionally or by name, matched case-insensitively), since `Skyrim.esm` is always loaded as master index `0` and a FormID valid for it never needs the file name argument's extra resolution step at all — `Game.GetForm(id)` returns exactly the same `Form` for less overhead. Automatically fixable: the fix rewrites the call to `Game.GetForm(id)`, keeping the original FormID argument (including any expression it's part of) and dropping the file name argument and its name if it was passed by name.
